title: "Natural Lenguaje ToolKit"

# Importación de Librerias

```{python}
import pandas as pdnp
from sklearn.datasets import fetch_openml
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV, cross_val_score
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import classification_report,ConfusionMatrixDisplay, confusion_matrix
```

# Cargar el Dataset

```{python}
df = fetch_openml('titanic', version=1, as_frame=True)['frame']
df
```

## Información del Dataset
```{python}
df.info()
```

# Preparación
## Filtrado

```{python}
df=df[['pclass', 'survived','sex','age','sibsp','parch','embarked']]
df
```


## Eliminación de datos nulos

```{python}
df = df[df['survived'].notna()]
df['survived'] = df['survived'].astype(int)
```

## Separación

```{python}
X = df.drop(columns='survived')
y = df['survived']
```

## Identificación de Features

```{python}
cat_cols = ['sex','embarked']
num_cols = ['age','sibsp','parch','pclass']
```

# PipeLine
## Preproecsamiento

### Categorilas
```{python}
cat_pipeline = Pipeline([
    ('imputacion_cat',SimpleImputer(strategy='most_frequent')), 
    ('encodage_cat',OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore')),
])
```

## Numerical PipeLines


```{python}
num_pipeline = Pipeline([
    ('imputacion_num',SimpleImputer(strategy='most_frequent')), 
    ('escalado_num',StandardScaler()),
])
```

## Preprocessor

```{python}
preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([
    ('cat',cat_pipeline,cat_cols),
    ('num',num_pipeline,num_cols)
])
```
## Pipeline de Clasificador

```{python}
pipeline = Pipeline([
    ('preprocessor',preprocessor),
    ('clasificador',KNeighborsClassifier())
])
```

## Train_test_split

```{python}
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X,
    y,
    test_size= 0.2,
    stratify=y,
    random_state=42,
)
```

## Parametros de KNN para ParamGrid

```{python}
param_grid = {
    'clasificador__n_neighbors': list(range(1, 51)),
    'clasificador__weights':['uniform','distance'],
    'clasificador__metric':['euclidean','manhattan','minkowski']
}
```


## GridSerach
```{python}
grid = GridSearchCV(pipeline, param_grid, cv=5, scoring='accuracy', n_jobs=-1)
grid.fit(X_train, y_train)
```


```{python}
best_model = grid.best_estimator_

```

```{python}
print("MEJORES PARAMETROS : \n",grid.best_params_['clasificador__n_neighbors'])
```


```{python}
print("Los Mejores Parametros: ", grid.best_params_)
```

```{python}
y_pred = best_model.predict(X_test)
```



```{python}
print("REPORTE DE CLASIFICACIÓN: \n", classification_report(y_test, y_pred))
```


```{python}
ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_predictions(y_test, y_pred)
```
